title: Every Space conversation email wears the Space's brand

source.ref: Owner ruling 2026-10-12 (LIVE-898): a message a Space sends through Frequency must look like the Space's. LIVE-898 covered the first message and the batch flush; every other outbound email on a Space's conversation still wore the Frequency masthead and a raw signed Reply-To.

detail: Shipped 2026-10-12. Every outbound email a Space sends on a conversation wears the Space's brand (resolveSpaceEmailBrand from the conversation's spaceId, passed to renderReplyEmail) and a Reply-To masked with the From's display name (withDisplayName), the signed per-thread alias riding underneath. Space lane: the console reply (app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/crm/conversations-actions.ts), the leader inbox reply on a Space's thread (app/(main)/lead/inbox/actions.ts), and the email bridge relays to the member, atomic and legacy (lib/comms/inbound.ts routeHouseReplyOutbound). Platform lane, output unchanged apart from the masked Reply-To: the platform CRM reply (app/(main)/admin/crm/conversations/actions.ts), the leader downline fan-out (lib/comms/leader-send.ts), the campaign conversation mode (lib/email-studio/send.ts), and the house forward to the agent (inbound.ts forwardInboundToHouse). The tenant alias and the inbound webhook are untouched.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const bad=[];for(const p of ['app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/crm/conversations-actions.ts','app/(main)/lead/inbox/actions.ts','lib/comms/inbound.ts','lib/comms/conversation-compose.ts','lib/comms/outbound-batch.ts']){const t=r(p);if(!/resolveSpaceEmailBrand\(/.test(t)||!/withDisplayName\(/.test(t))bad.push(p)}for(const p of ['app/(main)/admin/crm/conversations/actions.ts','lib/comms/leader-send.ts','lib/email-studio/send.ts']){if(!/withDisplayName\(/.test(r(p)))bad.push(p)}if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-899: Space brand or masked Reply-To missing in '+bad.join(', '));process.exit(1)}"
